instructions.name: route
expected_state_changes: debits accounts.user_source_token_account by data.in_amount, swapped through the routed venues
credits accounts.user_destination_token_account with the routed output
credits accounts.destination_token_account with the routed output when it is passed
credits accounts.platform_fee_account with the platform's share when it is passed
risk_rules: RISK: verify output amount matches expected within slippage tolerance
RISK: verify route does not include unknown/unverified DEX programs
